column1: # Character breakdowns (English), written for Hanyu from the open Make Me a Hanzi data.
# "(sound)" = the part that gives the pronunciation; other parts give the meaning.

column2: note
阝 place + 可 kě (sound). A prefix, and a sound in foreign names: 阿拉伯 Ālābó = Arab.
扌 hand + 立 lì (sound). To pull, which you do with your hand.
亻 person + 白 bái (sound). Here only for its sound, in 阿拉伯 (Arab).
Picture of a person with a pattern on the chest. Patterns became "writing, culture". As a suffix: a written language (法文).
讠 speech + 吾 wú (sound). Anything with 讠 is about words and language.
口 mouth + 阿 ā (sound). A sound you make with your mouth: ah!
Two strokes parting from each other (old meaning: to divide), borrowed for "eight".
口 mouth + 巴 bā (sound). A mouth-sound that softens a sentence into a suggestion.
扌 hand + 巴 bā (sound). To grasp; measure word for things held by a handle.
父 father on top + 巴 bā (sound) below.
Picture of a flame or the sun's rays: bright, white.
一 one + 白 bái (sound): a hundred.
A knife 刂 splitting jade 王 into two: dividing into groups, a class.
力 strength with two drops of sweat: to handle, to get things done.
八 divide + 厶 private: sharing out what was private = public, fair.
宀 roof + 至 zhì (sound): a room.
勹 wrapping around 巳 a baby: to wrap.
Picture of a baby with arms out and legs wrapped. Also a common noun ending (包子, 饺子).
木 wood (early cups were wooden) + 不 bù (sound): cup.
木 tree with a mark at the roots: root, origin; measure word for books.
Two people (匕) standing side by side: to compare.
车 cart + 交 jiāo (sound): to compare.
⺮ bamboo + 毛 hair: a bamboo brush tipped with hair, a pen.
另 another + 刂 knife: cut apart, separate, other.
白 + 勺. Originally "target"; now the most common particle: 我的 = mine.
Just remember it as "no, not". It turns into bú before a 4th tone (bú shì).
宀 roof + 各 gè (sound): someone under your roof, a guest.
Picture of vapor rising in layers: air, breath, gas.
艹 plant on top, 人 person in the middle, 木 tree below: the tea plant.
Simplified from 葉, leaf. 口 + 十 (just shapes here).
Simplified picture of a cart seen from above: axle and two wheels.
口 mouth + 乞 qǐ (sound): to eat.
A sprout growing out of a container: to go out.
禾 grain + 且 qiě (sound). Rent was once paid in grain.
讠 speech + 司 sī (sound): a word.
Old books (bamboo slips 曲) laid on a stand: a classic, a standard book.
A person with arms spread wide: big.
木 + 既 jì (sound): general, approximately.
Hands (⺍) and a roof (冖) over a child 子: a child learning under a roof.
大 a grown man with a hairpin 一 across the head: an adult man.
亻 person + 旦 dàn (sound, same as the word).
日 on top of 疋. Just remember: 是 = to be.
疋 + 虫 creature at the bottom: an egg, which creatures lay.
彳 walk + 十 and 罒 (an eye) + 一 + 心 heart: straight eyes and heart, virtue.
⺮ bamboo + 寺 sì: bamboo slips sorted by rank. Means "grade" and "to wait".
A cord wound around a stick, in order: order of birth, younger brother.
One stroke = one. Its tone changes: yí before a 4th tone (yígòng), yì before others (yìxiē).
占 zhàn (sound) + 灬 fire dots: a dot. Also "o'clock" (三点).
Picture of a person's legs: child. As a suffix it adds an "r": 哪儿 nǎr.
Lightning striking through a field: electricity.
讠 speech + 舌 tongue: words, speech.
者 zhě (sound) + 阝 city: first meant a capital city (dū); now mostly "all" (dōu).
讠 speech + 卖. Memory hook: reading aloud like a market seller calling out.
又 hand + 寸 hand: two hands facing each other, facing, correct.
走 walk + 己 jǐ (sound): to rise, to get up.
Two 夕 stacked: more and more, many.
小 small + one more stroke: even less, few.
亻 person + 我 wǒ (sound). Used for Russia (俄国).
Two lines = two.
Simplified from 發 "to send out" (and 髮 "hair"). 发音 = send out a sound.
立 on top of 日: a tongue making a sound in the mouth.
氵 water + 去 go: water always follows its course, a law, a method.
饣 food + 反 fǎn (sound): a meal, cooked rice.
户 door + 方 fāng (sound): a house, a room.
日 sun shining through 门 a doorway: a gap, a space between, a room.
八 divide + 刀 knife: to divide; a small unit (a cent, a minute).
冈 gāng (sound) + 刂 knife: hard; as an adverb, "just now".
氵 water + 巷 xiàng: a harbor. 香港 = Hong Kong.
巾 cloth (money was once written on silk): currency.
Picture of a tall tower: tall, high.
Hands lifting something together: to rise, to be in high spirits.
Two 可 stacked. Sound gē: elder brother.
A person 人 with a stroke under it: counting one by one, the general measure word.
纟 silk + 合 hé: silk was a common gift, to give.
Picture of a carpenter's square: work.
亻 person + 乍 zhà (sound): to make, to do.
Picture of an axe; used as a weight unit (half a kilo).
A person giving orders with the mouth 口: to manage.
贝 shell (old money) at the bottom: costly, precious.
女 woman + 生 shēng (born): the clan name passed down from the mother, a surname.
囗 borders around 玉 treasure: a country.
辶 walk + 不. Read hái: still, also. Read huán: to give back.
Left part + 韦 wéi (sound). Used for Korea (韩国).
二 two lines over 儿 a person, marking the head: first, origin; also a unit of money.
氵 water + 又. The Han River, then the Han people, then "Chinese".
宀 roof + 子 zǐ child (sound and meaning): a written character.
女 woman + 子 child: a mother with her child, good.
A person held back from behind: a long time.
口 mouth + 丂: to call out, then a number.
石 stone + 马 mǎ (sound): stones used for counting, a number.
口 mouth + 曷 hé (sound): to drink.
禾 grain + 口 mouth: grain for every mouth, harmony; also "and".
A face blackened by soot over a fire 灬: black.
彳 step + 艮 gèn (sound): very.
纟 silk + 工 gōng (sound): red, the color of dyed silk.
又 hand + 欠 open mouth: joyful.
辶 walk + 卬 áng (sound): to walk out to meet, to welcome.
扌 hand + 奂 huàn (sound): to exchange by hand.
A small box inside a big one (originally a spiral): to return.
又 + 鸟 bird: chicken.
Picture of a small table. Borrowed for "how many? a few".
宀 roof + 奇 qí (sound): to send, to mail.
宀 roof over 豕 a pig (families kept pigs at home): home.
Simplified 見: a person 儿 with a big eye on top, to see.
亻 person + 牛 ox: a man cutting an ox into pieces, an item.
Picture of an animal horn: horn, corner; 1/10 of a yuan.
Picture of a feather or hair: hair, fur; spoken word for jiao.
饣 food + 交 jiāo (sound): dumpling.
口 mouth + 丩: to shout, to call; to be called.
孝 + 攵 a hand holding a stick: to teach.
扌 hand + 受 shòu (sound, same): to hand over, to teach.
女 woman + 且 qiě (sound): elder sister.
A person 人 between two lines: in between, a go-between.
纟 thread + 召 zhào (sound): to link up.
A lid over a line: now, the present.
一 sky above 大 a person: sky, day.
辶 walk + 井 jǐng (sound): to go in.
纟 thread + 𢀖: the warp threads of a loom; to pass through, to manage.
王 jade + 里 lǐ (sound): the veins of jade, reason, to manage.
Picture of a bent arm: nine.
氵 liquid + 酉 a wine jar: alcohol.
丨 + 日 (simplified from 舊): old, used.
木 tree + 矞: tangerine tree.
见 see under a roof with marks on top: to feel, to be aware.
彳 step + 旦 + 寸 hand: to obtain. Light syllable in 觉得 (juéde).
口 mouth + 加 jiā (sound): only for sound, in 咖啡 coffee.
口 mouth + 非 fēi (sound): only for sound, in 咖啡 coffee.
Two hands lifting the bar of a gate: to open, to start.
手 hand over 目 eye: shading your eyes to look far.
Picture of an open mouth. Measure word for family members.
土 earth + 夬: a lump, a piece; spoken word for yuan.
Picture of a wheat plant, borrowed for "to come".
艹 plant + 监 jiān: the indigo plant, blue.
An old person bent over, with long hair and a cane: old.
Simplified from 師: master, teacher.
田 field + 土 earth: a village; also "inside".
亻 person + 两 liǎng two: two people.
Two people 从 under one frame: two, a pair.
车 vehicle + 两 liǎng (sound): measure word for vehicles.
雨 rain + 令 lìng (sound): small drops, a remainder, zero.
A round zero, used when writing numbers with characters (二〇二六).
卯 + 田 field: to stay, to keep.
A plant sprouting from the ground: to be born, life.
A roof-like shape: six.
木 wood + 娄 lóu (sound): a building with floors.
彳 walk + 聿 a writing brush: written rules to walk by, law.
女 woman + 马 mǎ (sound): mom.
Simplified picture of a horse: mane, legs, tail.
虍 tiger's head on top: tiger.
口 mouth + 马 mǎ (sound): the question particle.
Simplified from 買 (a net over 贝 money): to buy.
买 buy with 十 on top: to sell (one extra piece on top).
饣 food + 曼 màn (sound): steamed bun.
Simplified from 頭: head.
忄 heart + 亡 wáng (sound, "lost"): a lost heart, too busy.
氵 water + 殳: sunk under water, gone, not have.
A hand holding meat 月: to have.
The bolts of a gate: to close; a connection.
Silk threads 糸 hanging down: to tie, a link.
亻 + 十: in 什么 "what".
A light syllable in 什么 and 怎么.
羊 a headdress on 大 a person: beautiful.
女 woman + 未 wèi (sound): younger sister.
Picture of a doorway: door, gate.
Picture of rice grains around a stalk: rice.
禾 grain + 必 bì (sound): secret.
A hand holding a writing brush: book, writing.
Picture of a face; also stands for flour/noodles (from 麵).
夂 + 木 tree: a twig, long thin things.
夕 evening + 口 mouth: in the dark you call out your name.
日 sun + 月 moon: bright.
麻 má (sound) + 手 hand: to rub. Used for sound in 摩托车 (moto).
扌 hand + 乇: to hold up. Used for sound in 摩托车.
口 mouth + 那 nà: the question form of 那, which?
That. Add 口 and it becomes the question 哪 (which?).
此 this + 二: some, a few.
田 field + 力 strength: the one who works the field, male.
又 hand + 隹 bird: trying to catch a bird, difficult.
口 mouth + 尼 ní (sound): a particle (你呢? = and you?).
亻 person + 尔 ěr (old word for "you"): you.
亻 person + 门 mén (sound): plural for people.
你 + 心 heart: "you" said with respect.
Picture of a kneeling woman: woman, female.
区 qū + 欠: used for Europe.
Two 月 side by side: companions.
Two hands joined: friend.
口 mouth + 卑 bēi (sound): beer.
亻 person + 更 gèng: convenient (biàn); in 便宜 it's pián.
宀 roof + 且: suitable.
A level balance: flat, even.
木 wood + 反 fǎn (sound): a board.
月 body + 㐫: brain.
艹 plant + 平 píng (sound): apple.
Fruit 田 on a tree 木.
A horizontal stroke cut by a bent one: seven. Don't confuse with 匕.
氵 water + 气 qì (sound): steam.
丿 + 十: a thousand.
钅 metal + 戋 jiān (sound): money (coins were metal).
车 cart + 𢀖: light, not heavy.
讠 speech + 青 qīng (sound): please, to invite.
口 mouth at the 门 door: to ask.
耳 ear + 又 hand: taking an ear (a war trophy), to take.
土 + 厶: to go.
入 + 王 jade: whole, complete.
Picture of a person's two legs: person.
The people, citizens.
讠 speech + 人 rén (sound): to recognize.
讠 speech + 只: knowledge.
Picture of the sun: sun, day.
To use.
Three 口: many items, goods.
宀 roof + 谷 valley: to contain.
日 + 勿: easy; change.
Three lines = three.
Commerce, business.
广 building + 占 zhàn (sound): a shop.
A mark above a line: up, above, before.
Noon.
讠 speech + 隹 zhuī (sound): who?
Picture of a person with a big belly: body.
亻 person + 本 root: body.
A cross: ten.
A lid over a dish of food: food, to eat.
尚 shàng (sound) + 土 earth: a hall.
Picture of a hand with spread fingers.
木 wood + 几 jī (sound): a machine.
娄 + 攵 hand: to count (shǔ); a number (shù).
Picture of flowing water.
讠 speech + 兑: to speak.
A box 囗 with 儿 inside: four.
亻 person + 也: he.
女 woman + 也: she.
大 big + a dot: even bigger, too, very.
A particle for change or completion (太好了!).
氵 water + 昜: soup.
口 mouth + 斤: to listen.
Same, together.
尸 roof + 至 arrive: a room, a house.
A plan inside a frame: map, picture.
饣 food + 官 guān (sound): a building (restaurant, library).
夕 evening + 卜 fortune-telling: outside, foreign.
卯 mǎo (sound) + 贝 money: trade.
石 stone + 宛 wǎn (sound): bowl.
Ten thousand.
亻 person + 立 stand: the place where a person stands.
Picture of a weapon held in a hand: I, me.
Five.
A bird settling on its nest at sunset: west.
Picture of a tooth. Used for sound in 西班牙 (Spain).
艹 plant + 约 yuē: medicine (herbs).
A mark below a line: down, below, after.
A foot 止 ahead of a person 儿: first.
⺮ bamboo + 相 xiāng (sound): a box.
A stroke with two small dots: small.
木 wood + 交 jiāo (sound): school.
A person with long hair: long (cháng); elder, head (zhǎng).
To write.
讠 speech + 射 shè (sound): to thank.
亲 + 斤 axe: freshly cut wood, new.
亻 person + 言 words: a person's word, trust; a letter.
日 + 生 shēng (sound): star.
其 qí (sound) + 月 moon: a period of time.
Simplified from 習, wings practicing flight: to practice.
彦 yàn (sound) + 页 head: face, color.
Color.
To want, to need.
Also.
Picture of a robe with a collar: clothes.
Clothes; to wear.
矢 arrow in 匸 a box: medicine, doctor.
阝 + 完 wán (sound): a courtyard, an institution.
Two hands holding something together: together, total.
People gathering: to meet; can.
钅 metal + 艮 (sound): silver.
A crossroads: to walk (xíng); a firm (háng).
艹 flower + 央 yāng (sound): flower, hero; England.
Camp; to run a business.
Business, profession.
口 + 贝: a member, staff.
亻 + 尤 yóu (sound): excellent.
舟 + 皿 dish: a plate, a disk.
由 yóu (sound) + 阝 place: post, mail.
An office, a bureau.
Picture of raindrops falling from a cloud: rain.
Picture of an open umbrella.
Words, speech (the full form of 讠).
九 + 木: mixed.
士 + 心 heart: will; a record.
Again.
To be at, in.
乍 zhà (sound) + 心 heart: how?
木 + 羊 yáng (sound): shape, manner.
弓 bow + 长 cháng (sound): to stretch; measure word for flat things.
扌 hand + 戈 spear: to search; to give change.
昭 zhāo (sound) + 灬 fire: to shine.
Half of a tree trunk: a slice, a flat piece.
辶 + 文: this.
A hand 又 holding a branch 十: measure word for long thin things.
矢 arrow + 口 mouth: to know.
辶 walk + 首 head: road, way.
Only.
A line through the middle of a box: middle.
Heavy.
亻 person + 主 zhǔ (sound): to live.
Picture of a nose (people point to their nose for "me"): self.
Most.
辶 walk + 斤 jīn (sound): near.
日 day + 乍 zhà (sound): yesterday.
Two people 人人 sitting on the ground 土: to sit.
亻 person + 故: to do, to make.
爫 hand + 冖 roof + 友 friend: love.
化 huà (sound) + 十: splendid; China.
Two people sitting back to back: north.
Picture of a tall building on a hill: capital.
木 tree + 子: plum; a very common surname.
Two 日: prosperous.
氵 water + 告 gào (sound): vast.
Two trees: forest; a surname.
罒 net + 夕: a net; used for sound in names.
Orchid.
王 + 马 mǎ (sound): used for sound in names (玛丽 Mary).
Beautiful.
Wheat; used for sound in names (麦克 Mike).
To overcome; used for sound in names.
宀 roof + 女 woman: peace, safety.
Picture of a field divided into plots.
艹 + 方 fāng (sound): fragrant.
Three lines joined by one: king; a surname.
Simplified 東: the sun 日 rising behind a tree 木, east.
An ox 牛 cut down the middle by two strokes 丷: half.
辶 walk + 力 (a simplified part): the edge, the side you walk along. 这边 = this side.
疒 sickness + 丙 bǐng (sound): illness. Anything under 疒 is about illness.
艹 plant + 采 cǎi (sound; to pick): vegetables you pick, then any dish.
口 mouth + 昌 chāng (sound): to sing.
走 run + 召 zhào (sound): to run past, to go beyond. 超市 = supermarket.
A place where people met to trade: market, then city.
A tooth 牙 boring through a hole 穴: to go through; you go through your clothes when you put them on.
扌 hand + 丁 dīng (sound): to hit; many things you do with your hands (打电话 = to phone).
至 to arrive + 刂 knife (old form of 刀 dāo, sound): to arrive.
⺮ bamboo + 弟 dì (sound): bamboo strips laid in order; makes "first, second…" (第一).
见 to see + 礻 (from 示 shì, sound): to look at. 电视 = television.
景 jǐng (scene, sound) + 彡 rays: a shadow, an image. 电影 = film.
巾 cloth + 尚 shàng (sound): usual, often. 非常 = extremely.
Picture of a bird beating its wings: to fly.
钅 metal + 中 zhōng (sound): a bell, a clock. 分钟 = minute.
欠 open mouth (breath) + 哥 gē (sound): a song.
犭 animal + 句 gōu (sound): dog.
子 child + 亥 hài (sound): child.
王 jade + 元 yuán (sound): to play with jade trinkets, to have fun.
A ruler giving orders from his mouth 口; now also the simple form of 後: after, behind.
Picture of flames: fire.
A man carrying the harvested grain: the yearly harvest, a year.
A person 人 holding a tool: to use, by means of. In 可以 (may) and 以后 (after).
讠 speech + 果 guǒ (sound): a lesson.
冫 ice + 令 lìng (sound): cold. Two drops 冫 = ice.
犭 animal + 苗 miáo (sound, like the cat's "miao"): cat.
A hand holding a writing brush or tool: a task, a matter. 没事 = it's nothing.
Picture of a bear (厶 head, ⺼ body, 匕匕 claws): strong, able → can.
女 woman + 乃 nǎi (sound): milk; grandmother (奶奶).
氵 water + 票 piào (sound): to float. 漂亮 = pretty.
A lamp burning on a stand: bright. 漂亮 = pretty.
广 shelter + 木 wood: a wooden bed under a roof.
Old form: a foot on a boat moving ahead: in front, before.
执 zhí (sound) + 灬 fire: hot. 灬 at the bottom is fire.
日 sun + 寸 cùn (sound): the sun's movement, time. 时候 = time, moment.
亻 person + 侯 hóu (sound): to wait. 时候 = time, moment.
目 eye + 垂 chuí (to droop, sound): eyelids drooping, to sleep.
山 mountain + 夕 evening (simplified from an older form): a year of age.
Old picture of a snake under a roof 宀; borrowed for "it".
日 sun + 免 miǎn (gone, sound): when the sun has gone, evening, late.
口 mouth + 畏 wèi (sound): a call with the mouth: hello? hey!
页 head + 是 shì (sound): the forehead, then a title, a topic. 问题 = question.
壴 a drum + 口 mouth: drumming and singing, joy. 喜欢 = to like.
王 jade + 见 jiàn (to see, sound): jade showing its shine, to appear; now (现在).
心 heart + 相 xiāng (sound): to think with the heart: to think, to want, to miss.
亻 a person leaning against a tree 木: to rest.
自 nose + 心 heart: the breath; to rest (休息).
雨 rain + 彐 a hand (from 彗, a broom): the "rain" you sweep, snow.
木 wood + 奇 qí (sound): chair.
The sun 日 rising above 十 (the horizon, or a sprout): early, morning.
Old picture of a vessel on a stand: true, real; also "really" (真好).
A foot 止 stopping right at the line 一: straight, correct; 正在 = right now, doing.
卓 zhuō (tall, sound, shortened) over 木 wood: table.
Two wings back to back, turned away from each other: opposed → not. 非常 = extremely.
口 mouth + 丁 (sound part): to say yes, to approve → may, can. 可以 = may.
Picture of an ox's head with its horns: ox, cow. 牛奶 = milk.
A man standing straight: a scholar, an officer. 女士 = lady, Ms.
Picture of a crescent moon: moon, month.
青 qīng (sound) + 争 struggle. When the struggle stops, all is still: quiet.
邦 bāng (sound, a nation) + 巾 cloth, a flag. Rally under the flag to help.
扌 hand + a person kneeling and a hand 又: arresting and reporting. To report; 报名 = put your name down.
比 bǐ (sound) + 十 ten, a full count. Finished, complete: 毕业 = graduate.
辶 walk + 扁 biǎn (sound). Walk all over: everywhere; one time through, from start to end.
Fur 毛 on clothing 衣, worn on the outside: to show, to express.
氵 water + 寅 yín (sound). To perform, to act.
十 ten, everything + 尃 fū (sound). Broad, wide knowledge: 博物馆 = museum.
牛 ox + 勿 wù (sound). An ox was the thing of value: thing, object.
钅 metal + 昔 xī (sound). Wrong, mistaken.
厶 + 大 + 彡: originally stars over a person. To join, to take part: 参加, 参观.
又 again + 见 to see. To look again carefully: to observe, to visit.
力 strength + 口 mouth. Add the force of your words: to add, to join in.
扌 hand + 喿 zào (sound). To handle, to drill: 操场 = sports field.
土 earth + 昜 yáng (sound, shortened). An open piece of ground: field, square.
木 wood + 旦 dàn (dawn). To check, to look into: 查词典 = look up a dictionary.
羊 sheep + 工 work. Work done by a sheep is poor: bad, to fall short.
冫 two strokes + 欠 a person breathing out. Again and again: time, occurrence.
Two people 人人, one following the other: to follow, from.
⺮ bamboo + 具 tool: a bamboo abacus. To calculate; 打算 = to plan.
扌 hand + 斤 axe. To break off; 打折 = cut the price, a discount.
亻 person + 弋 yì (sound). One person standing in for another: to represent, generation.
A belt tying a robe: belt; to take or bring along.
⺌ small + 彐 a hand. To act as, to serve as; 当然 = of course.
灬 fire + 肰 rán (sound): to burn. Now used for "so, like that": 当然 = naturally.
火 fire + 丁 dīng (sound). A flame you light: lamp, light.
土 earth + 也 yě (sound). Ground, earth, place: 地方.
A plough or a square shape. Square, side, direction; 地方 = place.
刂 knife + 居 jū (sound). A play, a drama: 电视剧, 京剧.
厶 + 口: a raised platform. Platform, station: 电视台 = TV station.
忄 heart + 董 dǒng (sound). Understand with your heart: 懂了 = got it.
矢 arrow + 豆 dòu (sound). Things measured with an arrow are short: short.
钅 metal + 段 duàn (sound). To forge metal; 锻炼 = to forge the body, to exercise.
火 fire + 柬 jiǎn (sound). To refine in fire: 锻炼 = to train.
火 fire + 尧 yáo (sound). To burn; 发烧 = to run a fever.
羽 wings + 番 fān (sound). Wings flip over: to turn over; 翻译 = to translate.
